entities.summary: Bogolyubovo is a rural locality in Suzdalsky District of Vladimir Oblast, Russia, located some 10 kilometers (6.2 mi) northeast of Vladimir, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 4,729 (2021 census); 4,494 (2010 census); 4,218 (2002 census); 4,143 (1989 Soviet census); 3,900 (1969).
